title: Mr. Hakim Said Successfully Defends PhD Thesis at AWKUM
text:
The public defense of
Mr. Hakim Said
, PhD Scholar in the
Department of Political Science, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM)
, was successfully held at the university.

Mr. Hakim Said successfully defended his doctoral thesis titled
“The Foreign Policy of Pakistan (1999–2022): An Analysis”
, conducted under the supervision of
Prof. Dr. Zahir Shah, Pro-Vice Chancellor, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
.

The doctoral defense was evaluated by a distinguished panel of examiners comprising:

Prof. Dr. Zahid Anwar
, Former Dean, Faculty of Social Sciences, University of Peshawar

Dr. Amirullah Khan
, Chairman, Department of Political Science, Islamia College University, Peshawar

Prof. Dr. Manzoor Ahmad
, Chairman, Department of Political Science, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

The public defense provided an opportunity for the scholar to present and discuss his research findings and respond to questions from the examiners.

The defense was also attended by
faculty members and students
, who witnessed the important academic milestone.

The successful defense marks a significant achievement in Mr. Hakim Said’s academic journey and reflects the continued research and scholarly activities of the
Department of Political Science, AWKUM
.
